description: Plans du réseau régional is a dataset listed in Île-de-France Mobilités open data, an open data portal of a public transport authority, published or maintained by Île-de-France Mobilités. Ce jeu de données créé en avril 2020 présente la gamme des plans du réseau de transports en Île-de-France destinés à l’information voyageur. Coverage: France (network area of the operator or portal owner). The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Plans. Its keywords are Plan régional, Plateforme numérique. The portal shows 2026-09-07 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-nd/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-idfm-open-data-portal.
